verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents two token types: a global API token valid across all teams, and an Uptime API token scoped to one team and to Uptime resources only. Both are used as Bearer tokens. That is coarse scoping, narrowing a credential by team and product, but not true least-privilege. Missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes (e.g. read-only or per-resource), agent-specific credential issuance, documented token expiry or rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
